accepted.label: Calculating Expected Monetary Value (EMV) at Chance Nodes
accepted.description: Computing the expected value by multiplying outcomes by probabilities and summing.
coverage_criteria: Given a chance node with payoffs and probabilities, calculate the expected value.
Explain the formula for expected value at a chance node.
accepted.merge_rationale: Standalone concept covering the mathematical computation of EMV.

accepted.label: Expected Monetary Value (EMV) Criterion
accepted.description: Using EMV as a decision criterion by selecting the alternative with the highest expected monetary value, appropriate under risk neutrality.
coverage_criteria: Compute EMV from a payoff table and probabilities.
Explain why the EMV criterion represents a rational choice under risk neutrality.
accepted.merge_rationale: Standalone concept covering the application of EMV as a decision rule.
